en: Ah! Here is a peerless knight.
(A shame he wants to kill us.)
Hi， um， I'm Nicole!
Let's be friends? No?
Hm? What now?
This sword...
You want me to have it? All right...
Feels... incredible. Full of fury， and power!
It's like... he's speaking to me through the sword--telling me everything he went through.
Well， don't worry， friend. I'll finish what you started!
Rest in peace， valiant knight of the true crown.
I wish we had not come to blows. But I swear to strike down the source of our pain!
It must take some SERIOUS hard feelings to un-die.
I hope he rests easier knowing we've taken up his torch.
Your soul is at war， even in death. You feel betrayed.
I understand.
The voices have gone silent.
I hope they're at peace.
I have become aware that a bit of the old royal bloodline has dripped into the present.
A woman: one who could have been a great knight， but has chosen instead to sow disorder in the kingdom's finest moment.
Why， Serena? Your family died generations ago and the world moved on.
Hold your tongue， snake!
The world never moved on. You dragged it off its wheels!
My kin died so the magic of a dark wizard could mock the true glory of the throne!
You do have spirit. I can see a bit of the old queen's fire in you.
That look of defiance was the last expression she wore， my little princess.
P-Princess!?
Serena's... a princess? (So much for asking her out.)
Ah! I might have known! Her patriotic spirit， her clarity of mind--these are royal traits!
Sometimes it feels like everyone's a princess but me.
No! You're lying! My family has ruled this land since ancient times!
Father would have spoken of it， were House Valgar not the first to sit the throne!
Ha ha ha ha! I remember a warrior... He fought to his last breath the night your family was destroyed. Scores of my men died on his blade before he expired on the outskirts of town.
How very fitting that he should lead the last of you to me today!
I see. Then he is more than just some hero whose bones washed white with history.
He was a brave man who tried to protect my family.
The old king said before he died--
“Mine is a kingdom of swords.  These crimes， too， shall be  avenged by the sword.“
As a precaution， I ordered my soldiers to gather every scrap of steel and iron.
Not one sword in the realm had such power. But it appears I gave up too quickly.
The most powerful weapon in existence， unearthed by a ragtag band of nobodies! Ha! Had they and the sword found me instead of you， all of us would have been spared so much misery.
Explain yourself， Kanon. You already wielded absolute power in all but name.
What's so important that you had to destroy my family!?
Did you know our world was once home to three races?
Heaven and earth were ruled by two warring tribes called the Skyborn and the Earthblood.
As they fought viciously to eradicate each other，
the third race--our race-- could only cower in fear.
But that changed when the Skyborn gave humans a gift: power to see nature's workings.
So grateful were we for this “majestic logic，“ or “magic，“ we chose to help the Skyborn.
We battled the Earthblood at the cost of many human lives.
In the end， we did what the Skyborn never could， and cast the Earthblood into darkness.
But did the Skyborn thank us? Ha!
Oh， how the jealous fiends thanked us.
Fearful of our god-like power， they cast us into the same dark prison as the Earthblood. We who gave our lives for them!
Only the magically uninclined were spared， sparking a dreary epoch called the Age of Swords.
I waited an eternity for the moment I could escape my prison and restore magic to a world that sorely lacked it.
I subjugated the Earthblood's leader， and， in time， clawed my way back to freedom.
But when I told the royal family of the great power men had lost， they scoffed! The ungrateful fools deserved to be killed and replaced.
Replaced with us? My family are puppets for some VENDETTA?
Vendetta? Don't be petty. Humanity wants and needs this!
I warned you against choosing swords over sorcery， young Valgar. The king， at least， knows better than to try and pull his own strings.
Father is colluding with you? No... he would never...
My business now is with the band who found the sword.
That woman has led you astray and put your lives in danger.
Soon a world balanced by magic will be upon us. Why not think about your fellow man， and fight on behalf of the future we all deserve， hmm?
No. I'm a visionary!
The world will spin the way I want it to spin. With magic，  humanity will become the strongest race of all!
Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! What ARE you?
I shall pick you apart until I find my answer!
Fools! You will regret... siding with the Skyborn...
Ye who see magic's evils for what they are--come to me.
Enter my realm without fear， for I have been waiting.
The old monarchy forced my hand. They simply could not be brought to see the truth.
Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! Such incredible power...
But you mistake me for a mage. I AM A MASTER!
Word of your exploits has spread quickly， warriors.
Our own attempts to stand up to Kanon cost us our village and families. But today... You gave us vengeance and victory in one great stroke!
Bah! As long as the Skyborn rule on high， we will never have peace! The Earthblood answer to me now. With their power， I can finally set this world right!
You will regret being reborn into this world， fool! All of you will!
What have you done? This world will crumble without me! The Skyborn and Earthblood... will tear it apart...
Force brought me the power of the Earthblood， and force gave humanity back the power your forefathers died for!
Now， force will tear the proud Skyborn out of the heavens!
Nngh!? Impossible! Nothing can break that spell! We shall settle this later.
If you spoke truly， then these other races may be a threat.
But that does not absolve you.
It ends now. By the sword!
Ah， but you have just sealed your own fate. The Skyborn are watching!
You know the truth--and more damning still， they have seen that you believe me! You have already been judged.
Warriors! Do not be afraid. I wish you no harm.
There is a matter we must discuss. You wish to face Kanon? I can arrange for that... briefly.
I must have a way with monsters.
But it is time you and I severed our ties once and for all!
WHY!? Why can I not kill you? It's that accursed sword. What secret does it hold?
Graaah! Now even mortal men are walking around with these monsters' blades!
What secrets do the accursed things hold?
You haven't seen one because they come from a better time!
Before your magic polluted the world， there was an Age of Swords. Blades like this belonged to knights who served the true king--died protecting him from pretenders like your father!
What jape is this? True king? Pretenders?
Your mind's as far gone as these skeletons'. Shall I put you to rest by their side?
Would that you could， my prince. But it seems more direct intervention is required.
Still alive?
Our knights are getting soft.
Compared to the ones who served the true monarchy， your men are like babes in armor.
Maybe you need a true crown to serve to show your potential.
You need a real king to make a real knight， buddy.
Ha! One impostor breeds another.
Yeah， well， if they were the REAL royal knights， we would have got our butts handed to us!
What are you implying?
I've had more of this farce than I can stomach. En garde!
It's a bird! It's a plane!
Nope， it's our sexy frames! Who takes from the flabby and gives to the stacked? Just us， baby: the Glutes are back!
Whoopsy-daisy. Who do you think owns this wasteland?
Time to pay up in gold!
Or... I guess we accept golden warriors. Wait'll the boss gets a load of him!
What， you guys again? Ugh， you know the drill. Buns in gear， brigands! Take 'em to the boss.
Ha! Well met， trespassers.
Macho applauds your gumption as only Macho can.
Have you come bearing gifts?
That golden warrior will do.
You still owe Macho a golden warrior. Once he joins the Glutes， his well-textured armor will be oiled daily!
Ugh. Put a shirt on， knave!
Ha! You take YOUR shirt OFF， weakling!
Those are some sweet biceps for a prince whose family likes magic more than muscle! How much do those blades weigh?
Er... Macho. May I ask you a question?
Where did you get the sword in that box?
Ah! You like Macho's beefy sword?
This was our prize from robbing a royal storehouse. Why a bunch of wizard wimps would want it eludes Macho.
Want it? Our knights would never bother with a vulgar scrap of metal like that.
Correct. Yours would not.
This is from the Age of Swords， when the true monarchy wielded it against traitors like Kanon... and you!
More implications. What is this about?
What? Will you not cease these childish stories?
Ugh， it reeks of butt-sweat in here. I need some air.
Hmph. You low-life thieves can count yourselves lucky. Next time I see you is the day I cut you down!
Macho senses inner conflict...
In him， but also in you. You are taking on the crown?
Then go! Bring tone back to this dark and flabby world!
You rogues have kept too many secrets from me. What is it you think you know!?
I will tell you!
Enemies of the crown! You have taken your last step.
I cannot allow you to push my kingdom toward destruction!
Why， Valgar?
Because you and your father would rather do it yourself?
Yeah， that's your job， right? How's it feel to choke people with magic WE DON'T WANT!?
Us? You're the ones taking magic and twisting it! Magic is about free choice!
Yes， I see the destruction you speak of--and before me， the destroyer!
I'll push as many kingdoms toward destruction as I want! Wait， that came out wrong.
Shut up!
Well， you have improved a bit， I see.
Let's take this outside， where there's room to beat on you!
The world will spin the way I want it to spin. With magic，   humanity will become the strongest race of all!
Now， where were we?
You... nngh， DARE!
Hee hee hee! Why good morning， good knight! (See what I did there?)
Zur? Get your buffoons out of the way!
My goodness! Who tinkled in your spaulders?
I have business with you.
What are you-- What “business“?
Oh， how about your arrest and/or execution? What were Lord Kanon's exact words? Ah yes. “The fool would rather die than know the truth.“
Isn't he thoughtful? You must be so pooped from pretending to be a prince all the time!
Something else has come up. I will deal with you later!
Where is Kanon?
Take me to him. Now!
B-But I'm just the messenger!
I don't care who's real and who's a fraud! I stick with the winners! See? We're tight!
Correct! Power is Justice.   And justice calls for great power!
Now what kind of reckless  fools would pick a fight with the Blue Order?
Gash? What are you doing here?
Urp!
Uh... ohhhhh.
Hiya， Captain.
Fancy meeting you here.
Ick! So much for safety in the woods.
An unfortunate encounter.
But now that we know the truth about the crown， this is a battle we must fight!
Oh， sweet!
I'm dressed to match!
Oh， so you're the bunch causing all the ruckus.
Serena， is that you?
So you're one of the rebels holding His Majesty's feet to the fire? Hmm， can't solve this one with practice swords.
Han， is that you?
Huh. Ya mean you're one of the rebels holding His Majesty's feet to the fire? Guess it's time for another contest.
All right， you blue dogs! Go find the princess! I'll be done here in a second.
The princess? She's run away again?
Princess... Lucia's here!?
Guess I need work.
That Serena... Nngh! She fights like a dragon.
Well fought， Han...
A fearful monster... Wrong color armor， though.
Idiots! Don't worry about me! Do your job!
Fools! Arrgh... You have a job to do!
Hey!  My gang is mid-klepto， and you're muscling in on our prospecto.
I was right. Princess Lucia...
No wonder Gash came in person.
Huh? That's Lucia!
The captain said she'd run away again...
We Glutes know the scuttlebutt! Miss Princess here ditches the castle a lot. Guess she loves breakin' the rules! Just one prob--she ain't got no jewels.
Han? Why are you here? It's not... true， is it?
Lucia! Where are you? Why can't you just stay put!?
Uh-oh. Another rowdy baddy! C'mon， boys--let's skedaddy!
You!
Don't， Brother. These warriors just saved me from bandits.
Besides， you need to know why I left the castle this time.
It wasn't out of curiosity!
Why， then?
There is no excuse for disrupting life at the castle for these excursions!
Yes there is. I found out something I shouldn't have.
I overheard a conversation between Kanon and a horrible monster. It was terrifying!
I know why they want to force magic on the world... and who you and I really are.
It is not polite to eavesdrop， Princess. I must punish you.
Lucia， find someplace to hide.
Not the castle--it isn't safe.
But Brother...
Go. Now!
Nice， let me shake your... Wait， which piece is your hand?
You slippery rogues.
Luck cannot save you now!
Don't!
Lucia! Why are you here?
This is a battlefield! Get back inside the castle!
Lucia?
Stop this， Brother. Our family is bringing ruin to the kingdom!
Don't be dramatic， Princess. The people may be slow to adopt magic at the scale I-- we desire， but such is progress.
No one “adopts“ anything!
You give them no choice， just as you give my family no choices. I know the truth!
Then I suggest you WATCH YOUR TONE.
You're not royalty. You are a figurehead， one I can cut off and replace as I see fit!
Lucia， leave here at once.
Kanon has lost his mind!
No! I will not leave until he is punished!
I said go， Lucia! Now!
Be at peace， humans.
You stand in the Skyborn's heavenly realm， far above the earth.
I summoned you to my side so that you might understand our intentions.
While battling Kanon， you must have sensed the wicked forces at work; he was relegated to the darkness for a reason.
But now we face a larger threat: an Earthblood who hides among your royalty.
She has tricked Kanon into sheltering her in the castle.
To keep humanity safe， you must slay this impostor and all who answer to her.
May the Skyborn count on you?
A fine answer. I will speed you on to the castle. Go， and purge your world of evil!
As you wish.
Then I shall return you to the castle.
You question us? Unwise.
Take a moment to reflect upon the error of your ways.
We acknowledge your strength.
Now， show us you have wisdom. The Earthblood seek to break this world's delicate balance!
You have the power to intervene.
What is your answer?
Will you slay the Earthblood's pawns， starting with this man?
Correct.
However， this man has been cleansed of evil. The question was a test.
He is your adversary no more.
The Valgar whose life you must take is that of this boy's father， King Valgar-- the Earthblood impostor.
That is your right.
Then go now， and end this conflict as ordinary warriors.
A foolish reply. It has cost you a powerful ally!
Leave our sacred realm!
I have made many mistakes. I know that now.
I thought the blood in my veins was justification enough for all my actions.
Instead of serving my subjects， I sought only to serve myself. Words cannot express my shame.
But I vow to change that! From this day forward， my life belongs to my people. I will defend them at any cost!
So， you man-creatures have refused the Skyborn's help， but wish the Earthblood harm?
Foolish. But， as you wish.
I look forward to seeing if your kind has learned anything during my long slumber.
Is that true!? The king is a demon doppelganger?
What!? You mean the king is some kind of demon?
No way! The king's not human!?
Our kingdom， ruled by another race? Could it be true?
Wow. Guess they'll put a
crown on just about anybody.
Fortune smiles upon us! Let's smash these doors down and put an end to the tyrants!
Evil still lurks in the castle.
But we'll soon fix that. You liberate the town!
Wait! Bad idea.
The king will be guarded by a host of magical creatures. The castle should be our job. You take care of the town!
Not so fast! Kanon will have trained other mages. It's not safe.
Take care of the townspeople. We'll storm the castle.
Don't be fools! You underestimate the royal family's dark powers.
Stay here. Liberating the castle must fall to us.
Actually， we were going for “covert.“ Green stands out.
But why don't you babysi-- I mean PROTECT the townsfolk?
Ye who despise the powers of evil， I commend you.
One day， you shall serve us as a powerful force. The Earthblood hide within the castle walls. Go now-- and end them!
If you wish to protect the people， you must exterminate the false monarchy.
Come to me， warriors. I will help you see this task through.
Father! Is it true?
Kanon said we are not of royal blood! That we are just pawns in his schemes to bend  the world to the way of magic!
So what if we are? Let Kanon have his way with the kingdom. It's no concern of ours.
Did those words truly just issue from the mouth of THE KING?
I'll end your reign right here!
Oh yes， Valgar. Threaten him now， AFTER he's brought the land to ruin. Very noble.
Need some counseling， guys?
Step into my office.
Couldn't you have had this conversation a few chapters ago? Really.
A family squabble?
How heartbreaking.
Oh， they're having some warm-and-fuzzy time! That's so sweet!
Hmph. You again? Stay out of this!
You shameless puppet!
Our land is in shambles. Don't you care?
If you don't care about your people， then it's time you vacated the throne.
I'm with Valgar. This king's a royal donkey.
I am appalled. You have no claim to a kingdom you do not love!
You're a terrible king! I bet you didn't even read my letters!
Ha ha ha ha! Why should the Earthblood care what befalls the human realm?
You creatures are stepping stones to a higher purpose.
Farewell， fools. The time to shed this hideous disguise has drawn near.
Warriors capable of ending the Earthblood! At last...
I have been waiting for mortals of your caliber.
Come to my side， brave ones.
Why would you seize the throne， if not for power?
You became a king just so Kanon could get all the power?
So， you became a king， but you don't care about power?
How， in good conscience， could you cede power to a madman?
Why would you want to be king if you don't make the rules?
Ha ha ha! I seek more power than this human realm could ever offer.
But being king has its advantages; I could keep a  watchful eye on Kanon while we Earthblood gathered strength.
Soon， our use for this human world will end. Unless， of course， it were to yield capable warriors. Survive this next trial， and you may look upon my true form.
No， Valgar! Killing the king achieves nothing!
Stop it! Killing the king won't solve anything!
Whoa， whoa， time out! What is going on here?
Easy， lad. Taking your father's life will not undo his mistakes.
Hey! Boys!
Do you need to take a time out?
Ha ha ha ha! You and your human sympathy.
Instead of worrying about me， worry about Kanon.
His creations still stand poised to overrun your land.
At last， the king is dead! We are free of his wicked tyranny!
Ooh， celebrities!
We must sing of your exploits. But first， find the prince! We'll secure the throne.
What!? Father!
He just... vanished...
Huh? What manner of creature...
Great， what the heck is attacking us now!?
Who invited these uglies?
Hm? These beasts are not from our world.
Ugh! Giant lizards!
Birds? Goats? Whatever.
Father... is possessed? No， I refuse to accept it!
The mechs! They're still operative!?
At last! Warriors who can stand against the Earthblood!
Perhaps you can rid this world of its true evils.
Annngh!
You intractable pests! I refuse to play games with you any longer!
My thoughts exactly!
Fools. What did that solve?
Not even death... will quell this rage...
It grieves me to say this... but you were right. I believed in Kanon--that he would revive our kingdom， keep our people safe with his mechs and golems.
I thought I would be the cornerstone of our future.
Not some smoothed pebble on his game board...
What have I done?
Our kingdom can be rebuilt， but not with regret or sorrow. Join us， Valgar. If you fight as fiercely for good as you did for evil， we've hope yet.
The Skyborn and Earthblood?
You intend to face them!?
Kanon's mechs. Yes， we must stop them!
I know of a tunnel further in. Kanon had it sealed off， but perhaps now... Come with me.
You've just talked a lot， that's what. How about a little action?
News flash， Pebble--
The world isn't safe yet! Pull it together!
Save your regrets.
A lion with a singed tail must wear his mane more proudly!
Aw， save it. You've got the whole rest of your life to feel bad!
Right now， you need to focus on not screwing up worse.
What!? They've caught me? Impossible! My power exceeds theirs!
And mine yours.
King Valgar? But... how the devil did you get here?
Fool. You style yourself “Conqueror of the Earthblood.“ But no human conquers US.
Did you think we'd forgotten that you helped the Skyborn banish us to darkness? Die， you pathetic pawn.
I learned a thing or two from Kanon about replacing kings.
And now that our power has sufficiently returned， WE shall tear the Skyborn from the heavens! That vengeance was never his right!
Be comforted， humans. You stand before the ruler of the Earthblood， the greatest of all races.
I have observed many battles over the eons， but you fight unlike any other man-creatures. You possess... exceptional traits. Therefore， I wish to share a secret with you.
Your race and mine began the same.
Kanon has only told you half of what you need to know. But listen， and I can give you the absolute truth. I can reveal this world's true evil.
Humans! Always making it about race. But ignoring the truth will not exempt you from it.
So that is your only concern?
Your tiny slice of the world? Then go. Seek your own purpose.
A brave answer.
Ahead you shall be pitted against my Earthblood kin. Should you defeat them， I will accept you as worthy warriors.
This cannot be... The king， a demon!?
A demon wearing the crown? What next?
First the king's a fraud， and now he's a DEMON fraud? I give up.
A demon king! Where do the deceptions end?
This is mind-blowing!
The king is a chick! (I think?)
Hmph. Enter the self-styled “royal entourage.“
How long did it take you and Kanon to concoct that absurd fairy tale?
You and he are alike: the only royal blood in your veins is that which you have leeched away from my family in your quest for power!
Ha ha ha! Can not even the land's finest knight--the king's own SON--see the facts that lie so plain beneath the surface?
There is no one in this kingdom you can trust-- not even me.
Kanon spoke truly， I'm afraid. He manipulated me and my kin， intending to use our power and wage war upon the Skyborn.
But that vengeance was never his right! It is ours， the Earthblood's destiny to tear those tyrants from the heavens!
You monster! What have you done with my father!?
All of these lies must stop! I am the true prince， and this throne is mine to defend!
Oh， shut up， you weevil.
Take the throne; the affairs of this world are beneath us.
Just as our affairs are no concern of yours.
And so the truth is laid bare.
Your kingdom has been dancing at the end of that Earthblood monster's strings.
Time grows short. The Earthblood will conquer your lands on their way to the skies.
Rise up now， ye warriors-- and protect your human world!
Valgar! BABE! Help is on the way!
Do I know how to make an entrance or what? Forget Nick! “Right in the Zur of time!“ That's what they oughta say!
You anarchists are persistent.
I refuse to believe Kanon's lies about the throne.
But even if they are true， and the Earthblood or whatever they're called are where we get our power--so what?
I will seize the throne from my weakling father and bring the demons in line!
Ha ha ha! Stupid boy. He hasn't the slightest idea who has been controlling whom.
I'd like to see you try!
Foolish man-creature.
Do you really think we Earthblood would bow down to one as weak as you?
We no longer need you humans to shelter us while we nurse ourselves back to full strength. We are ready to destroy the Skyborn now!
What!? Kanon's familiars...
They were Earthblood!? I have been deceived!
Impossible! A demon was posing as the king!?
What!? The king's a demon!
Um， did the king just turn into a demon?
What!? The king was a demon in disguise all along?
Whoa! I guess they'll give a crown to anybody these days.
Know your place， humans.
There is no room for your kind in this eternal struggle between Earthblood and Skyborn.
If you try to interfere， I will not hesitate to wipe you from existence!
So these are the Earthblood.
So these are Earthblood.
Gross! These are Earthblood?
So， these grotesque monsters are the Earthblood's true form.
Eww， nasty! They smell like dirty!
I summoned you to my side so that you might understand our intentions. Listen well to what I have to say.
If you wish you save your world， you need to open your eyes to a greater threat.
One of the Earthblood hides among your human royalty.
She has tricked Kanon into sheltering her in the castle， and intends to plunge the world into darkness.
You must decide: will you destroy all pawns of the Earthblood， starting with this man?
However， we have already purged this man's heart of evil.
The prince is no longer the adversary you need fear.
The danger is King Valgar， who is really the Earthblood ruler.
Ah. A bold reply， or a desperate attempt to escape?
Very well， so be it. We will release you and this man. Go， fight your petty battle.
A foolish reply. It has cost you a powerful ally. May you wander forever in your human halls of ignorance!
I realize now I have been fighting for the wrong cause.
What I have seen here all but proves Kanon spoke the truth.
I know apologies come cheap...
But I am sorry. From this day forward， I promise my life belongs to my people. I will defend them at any cost!
That cannot be! The king is a demon doppelganger?
You're kidding!? The king's not human?
Is that true!? Our kingdom is secretly under demon rule?
The king's a demon!? Whoa!
I ask again: listen to what I have to say. I can reveal the true nature of this world.
I have observed many battles over the eons， but you possess qualities unlike any other man-creatures I have seen.
Therefore， I wish to share a secret with you: your race and mine began the same.
Then I am afraid you and I must sever our ties. Permanently!
